content.text: No restrictive covenant on Client exists anywhere in the document; §2(a) expressly confirms the opposite. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Client, so the rule sits at the preferred position. Section 2(a) (p0022/p0024) grants only a non-exclusive licence and affirmatively confirms Client is not obligated to use the Interface and is free to acquire, develop, licence or otherwise use competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink IP non-infringement and existing confidentiality obligations, which are ordinary IP/confidentiality terms, not competitive restraints). Client's covenants in §8 (compliance, notification, access limitation, spamming) contain no restraint on the businesses Client may operate or the products it may buy or build. The credit-report sourcing sentence in §3(i) (p0042) applies only where Client voluntarily requests underwriting approval "through a System using the Interface" and, read with the express freedom in §2(a), is not an exclusivity or field-of-use restriction. The "Non-Competition Agreement" referenced at §8(d) (p0054) is invoked solely as a limitation on the licence Client grants TrueLink to use Credit Data — i.e., it constrains Vendor and benefits us — so it is not flagged. No redline proposed.
